name: desktop
description: Workforce Monitor desktop agent (login, device registration, and start/stop time tracking)
author: Rinon <rinon.ten@onja.org>

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build && pnpm rebuild:electron && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && pnpm rebuild:electron && dotnet publish ../native/win/resolver/WinResolver/WinResolver.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && pnpm rebuild:electron && native/darwin/firefox-ax-helper-swift/build.sh && electron-builder --mac --publish never
